THE ECG MACHINES The ECG machine is a diagnostic tool used to measure the electrical activities of the heart. -We have the 3,6 and 12 channels machines THE 3-CHANNELS MACHINES RECORDS AND PRINTS 3 LEADS OF ECG DATA AT A TIME FROM THE STANDARD 12 LEADS. CYCLES THROUGH THE 12 LEADS IN BATCHES IT DISPLAYS 3 LEADS AT A TIME EXCLUDING THE RHYTHM LEAD. THEY TYPICALLY USES 63MM OR 80MM PAPER WIDTH MOSTLY USED IN AMBULANCES AND FIELD CLINICS BECAUSE THE ARE PORTABLE AND VERY HANDY.
